zachary.gloss: A en given name, English vernacular form of Zacharias, Zachariah and Zechariah.

zagreb.gloss: The capital and largest city of Croatia.

zaire.gloss: (historical) Former name of the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a country in Central Africa; used from 1971–1997.

zakat.gloss: (Islam) Almsgiving, usually in the form of an annual tax on certain types of property which is then used for charitable purposes; the third of the five pillars of Islam.

zambezi.gloss: A river in Southern Africa, flowing south and west from Zambia through east Angola and Zambia and then east along the border between Zambia and Zimbabwe into and through central Mozambique to the Indian Ocean.

zambia.gloss: A country in Southern Africa. Official name: Republic of Zambia. Formerly called Northern Rhodesia.

zamboanga del norte.gloss: A province of Zamboanga Peninsula, Mindanao, Philippines. Capital and largest city: Dipolog.

zamboanga del sur.gloss: A province of Zamboanga Peninsula, Mindanao, Philippines. Capital: Pagadian. Largest city: Zamboanga City.

zamboanga sibugay.gloss: A province of Zamboanga Peninsula, Mindanao, Philippines. Capital: Ipil.

zanzibar.gloss: An island region of Tanzania in the Indian Ocean.

zaozerne.gloss: A rural settlement, the administrative centre of Zaozerne selrada, Eupatoria Raion, the Crimea, Ukraine, founded in 1861.
A village in Novotroitske settlement hromada, Henichesk Raion, Kherson Oblast, Ukraine, founded in 1907.
A village in Ladyzhyn urban hromada, Haisyn Raion, Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine, founded in the early-seventeenth century.

zaragoza.gloss: A city, the regional capital of Aragon, Spain.

zazen.gloss: (Buddhism) A form of seated meditation in Zen Buddhism.

zeal.gloss: The fervour or tireless devotion for a person, cause, or ideal and determination in its furtherance; diligent enthusiasm; powerful interest.

zebra.gloss: (pejorative, slang, ethnic slur) A biracial person, specifically one born to a Sub-Saharan African person and a white person.

zebra crossing.gloss: (UK, Irish, Commonwealth) A pedestrian crossing featuring broad white stripes painted parallel to the street.

zebra finch.gloss: A small Australasian weaverbird of the genus Taeniopygia that has markings similar to a zebra.

zebulun.gloss: (biblical character) Tenth son of Jacob, by his wife Leah.

zechariah.gloss: (biblical character) A king of Israel mentioned in the second book of Kings.

zeitgeist.gloss: The spirit of the age; the taste, outlook, and spirit characteristic of a period.

zen.gloss: (religion) A school of Mahayana Buddhism characterized by sudden enlightenment achieved by indirect means and principally associated with China and Japan.

zenith.gloss: (astronomy) The point in the sky vertically above a given position or observer; the point in the celestial sphere opposite the nadir.

zephaniah.gloss: A book of the Old Testament and the Hebrew Tanakh.

zephyr.gloss: Any light refreshing wind; a gentle breeze.

zero.gloss: (linguistics) Present at an abstract level, but not realized in the surface form.
The numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero.
The cardinal number occurring before one and that denotes no quantity or amount at all, represented in Arabic numerals as 0.

zero growth.gloss: A stationary condition, e.g. in an economy, where growth does not occur.

zest.gloss: (by extension) Enthusiasm; keen enjoyment; relish; gusto.

zesty.gloss: Having a piquant or pungent taste; spicy.

zeus.gloss: (Greek god) Supreme ruler of all Greek gods, husband to Hera.

zhejiang.gloss: A coastal province in eastern China, running from Hangzhou Bay to Fujian. Capital: Hangzhou.

zhuang.gloss: The language of these people, belonging to the Tai language group.

zhvanets.gloss: A village, the administrative centre of Zhvanets rural hromada, Kamianets-Podilskyi Raion, Khmelnytskyi Oblast, Ukraine, first mentioned in 1431.

ziggurat.gloss: (archaeology) A temple tower of the ancient Mesopotamian valley, having the form of a terraced pyramid of successively receding stories

zimbabwe.gloss: A country in Southern Africa. Official name: Republic of Zimbabwe. Formerly called Southern Rhodesia or Rhodesia.

zinc.gloss: (countable) A single atom of this element.

zineb.gloss: An organic fungicide and insecticide sprayed on cereal grasses, fruit trees, etc.

zip.gloss: (intransitive, followed by a preposition) To move rapidly (in a specified direction or to a specified place) with a high-pitched sound.

zip fastener.gloss: A fastener used in clothing, bags, etc, comprised of two rows of teeth that are made to fit into each other by moving a slider along their length and opened again by moving the slider in the other direction.

zirconium.gloss: A chemical element (symbol Zr) with an atomic number of 40, a strong, lustrous, grey-white transition metal mainly used as a refractory and opacifier.

zither.gloss: (string instrument) A musical instrument consisting of a flat sounding box with numerous strings placed on a horizontal surface, played with a plectrum or fingertips.

zitting cisticola.gloss: A passerine bird of species Cisticola juncidis, family Cisticolidae, distributed across Africa, Eurasia, and Australasia.

zmiyovka.gloss: An urban-type settlement and urban settlement, the administrative centre of Sverdlovsky Raion, Oryol Oblast, Central Federal District, Russia, first mentioned in 1868.

zodiac.gloss: (astrology) The twelve equal divisions of the zodiacal region into signs or houses, each named for a prominent constellation in the region.
(astronomy) The ecliptic: the belt-like region of the celestial sphere corresponding to the apparent path of the sun over the course of a year.

zodiac sign.gloss: (astrology) Any of the twelve star signs corresponding to the constellations which make up the zodiac.

zoisite.gloss: (mineral) A mineral with orthorhombic crystals, Ca2Al3(SiO4)(Si2O7)O(OH).

zone.gloss: (geography, now, _, rare) Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and

zone out.gloss: (informal, intransitive) To stop paying attention and think about something else, or to think about nothing

zoo.gloss: (countable) A park where live animals are exhibited.

zoogeography.gloss: The scientific study of the geographical distribution of animal species.

zoological garden.gloss: (formal) A zoo, a park where live animals are exhibited.

zoology.gloss: The part of biology relating to the animal kingdom, including the structure, embryology, evolution, classification, habits, and distribution of all animals, both living and extinct.

zoom lens.gloss: (photography) A lens containing a mechanical assembly of inner lenses, allowing the focal length to be changed rapidly.

zoonosis.gloss: (biology, microbiology) An animal disease, such as rabies or anthrax, that can be transmitted to humans.

zoophilia.gloss: The human sexual attraction or arousal to non-sapient animals.

zoroaster.gloss: An ancient Iranian prophet after whom the indigenous Iranian ethnic religion, Zoroastrianism, is named, also venerated in Mithraism.

zoroastrianism.gloss: (scholarly) The historical (pre-Islamic) indigenous beliefs and practices of the Iranian peoples.

zorro.gloss: A fictional character, a daring and mysterious avenger, created in 1919 by pulp writer Johnston McCulley.

zulu.gloss: The language of these people, a Bantu language; isiZulu.

zurich.gloss: The capital city of Zurich canton, Switzerland, on Lake Zurich.

zuricher.gloss: A native or inhabitant of Zurich.

zwickau.gloss: A town and rural district of Saxony, Germany.

zwitterion.gloss: (chemistry) A molecule, such as an amino acid, that carries both a positive and a negative charge.

zygote.gloss: (cytology, also, attributive) A eukaryotic cell formed from the fusion of two gametes during a fertilization process. [from late 19th c.]
